note: Small family-owned RV park (since 1980) off the US 1 bypass in Moncure, Chatham County, about 1 mile from a Jordan Lake boat ramp. Mostly a long-stay park: it serves out-of-town workers, charges rent with a late fee, and offers mail delivery, phone/cable service and storage buildings at the sites. --Claude
summary: Operator's own (2006-2009-era) site: confirmed full hookups (water/electric/sewer) and 25 sites; added phone/in-person reservations. No rate posted ('Please call us for pricing'). Note rewritten to drop the site facts and say what the park mostly is. Not stated: amperage, season, max rig length, showers.
flags: Long-stay test 2 fails (likely drop): the park is long-stay in character - 'serves as a perfect location for out-of-town workers', 'Pay your rent on the day it's due ... $5.00 late fee', 'Residential mail delivery available at most sites', local phone and cable service, private storage buildings, 'Renter with washer and dryer need to notify owners', 'additional charge for electric heaters' - and it posts no nightly rate ('Our camper & RV rates vary from season to season. Please call us for pricing.') and has no booking engine (phone or in person only). An RV Life $ tier does not stand in for a long-stay park.
Stale website: cottenscampground.com is a static site marked 'Copyright 2006-2009'; it still loads, with phones 919-542-3812 (entry's), 919-548-2644 and 919-542-1685.
